Method of Attack: Creates ransom notes named _how_recover_<3 letter id>.HTML and _how_recover_<3 letter id>.TXT in each folder with encrypted files
Uses vssadmin.exe to clear Shadow Volume Copies to prevent recovery
Impacted Systems: Systems with encrypted files using .ccc extension
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note files named _how_recover_<3 letter id>.HTML and _how_recover_<3 letter id>.TXT
